## Meta Faces India Safe Harbor Liability Risk After Restricting Modi-Related Post

Losing safe harbor in India would expose Meta to direct content liability in a large emerging market and could force costly moderation investments or platform constraints — the precedent-setting nature of the case makes it relevant beyond India alone.

- Meta faces a potential loss of safe harbor liability protections in India following a decision to restrict a post related to Prime Minister Modi.
- The safe harbor threat has broad platform-liability implications beyond the specific content decision.
- Geopolitical and regulatory dimensions intersect: content moderation at the request of government creates precedent risk across markets.
- No timeline for a regulatory ruling or specific legal mechanism is cited in coverage.
